The Weekly Stellar

Learning

Culmination of Classes 3, 4 and 5

Outstanding performance by the children. Students presented their learning on stage, in their classrooms and at their own stalls, while parents and guests looked on. Kudos to all the teachers who guided them here.

Learning

Roti Making Activity

Every class took part. Children cooked their rotis on the pan, learned about safety, cleanliness and presentation, then shared what they made with friends and teachers.

Staff

CM Meeting of Teachers

Teachers met to conclude the Theme Material, bringing the current theme's planning and resources to a close before the new theme begins.

Safety

Fire Drill

A fire drill was held this week. Students joined a lively safety session on sensing danger and knowing how to respond, with plenty of hands up to answer.

Community

Parent Teacher Meeting

Special thanks to all teachers for making the meeting smooth and effective. Every conversation helped parents and school work as one team.

In remembrance

Wafaat of Al Syed ul Ajal Shehzada Idris Bs Vajihuddin

We received the sad news of the Wafaat of Al Syed ul Ajal Shehzada Idris Bs Vajihuddin. Our children gathered for Tilawat ul Quran.
